slogan: Turn the debt you already carry into a liquidity war chest at your fingertips, mapped against your taxes and ready to deploy the moment opportunity arises.
sloganShort: Every dollar of debt you owe, turned into a war chest ready to deploy the moment opportunity arises.
status: 68 proprietary engines, 57 with a drafted patent application. None filed yet.
declarations: We built this because nothing we could find put all of these pieces on one screen. Judge it for yourself.
Most planning software models a plan. We set out to build a system that runs one, connecting calculators that other tools keep separate.
New strategies reach your plan only after the engine, the sources and a licensed review agree on them.
You already have the money, the attorneys and the consultants. What you have never had is one system that sees all of it at once and moves every piece in the right order.
In your first week here you may learn things about your own money that years of advisory relationships never put in front of you, because we model pieces most tools leave out.
If it helps you, tell a colleague. That is the only marketing we want.
expect: One machine, not a stack of advisors. Every calculator we own snaps to a single base, so a mortgage decision, a Roth conversion and a practice choice are never planned in isolation again.
Your debt treated as an asset. Every dollar you owe is modelled as borrowing power, sequenced against taxes, so it becomes liquidity you can deploy instead of interest you surrender.

Evidence beside every estimate. The insurer's illustration shows the forward view the rules allow, and beside it the historical record of how the same crediting formula would have behaved, decade by decade. Past index performance is not indicative of future results.
Protection designed before anything happens. Divorce, lawsuit and creditor exposure mapped under your own state's rules, while it can still be changed, for a licensed attorney to confirm.
Perfectionism as a standard. We are not here to win your business with promises. We are here to show you the numbers, hypothetical and based on your facts, and let you measure them in the first week.
founderMessage: I'm Sam Russell. I built this because every physician I have ever sat across from had the money, the attorneys and the consultants, and still had never seen their whole financial life in one place, moving as one system. That is what this is. Sixty-eight proprietary engines that model every dollar you owe as borrowing power, sequence your taxes for a lifetime, and test the plan on your own facts before you commit to it. I have not found anything else built this way. Read the claims below. It takes ten minutes. Everything here is hypothetical and educational, not tax, legal or investment advice, and the life insurance and annuities it models are issued by insurance companies. Then decide for yourself.

claims.name: HELOC-to-IUL Arbitrage Optimization Engine
claims.lead: Imagine you could borrow against your house at a low price, say three cents per dollar, and pay that money into a permanent life insurance policy, an indexed universal life (IUL) policy, whose account is credited at a rate you assume, say seven cents per dollar.
claims.detail: This invention models the best order to draw on a home equity line of credit, a HELOC, and fund the policy. With a participating (indexed) loan option, the loaned value may keep receiving index credits under the carrier's terms; with a standard loan it is credited at a declared rate. Based on your facts, it shows a hypothetical date your mortgage could be paid off with policy loans, and the loans you could take later, cycle after cycle. Policy charges, loan interest and the HELOC rate all reduce the result, and the spread can turn negative. Loans from a policy that is not a modified endowment contract and stays in force are generally not taxable income; a lapse with a loan outstanding can create a large tax bill. All premiums paid and all interest credited, less policy charges, equal the account value.

claims.name: Debt-to-Positive-Liquidity War Chest Transmutation Engine
claims.lead: Every dollar you owe is modelled as borrowing power and sequenced against your taxes, so debt becomes liquidity you can deploy instead of interest you surrender.
claims.detail: The war chest is not a loan. It is the order in which your existing obligations, equity and tax position are arranged so capital is waiting when opportunity arrives.

claims.name: Cascading Multi-Calculator Financial Planning Engine
claims.lead: Thirty-five different financial calculators snap together on one base. Change one number in one place, like your income, and everything connected to it changes with it, automatically.
claims.detail: Your income moves the retirement calculator. The retirement calculator moves the tax calculator, which in turn moves the mortgage-payoff calculator, which affects the next-home-purchase calculator, which flows straight into your passive income. Everything is connected together.

claims.name: AI Whisper Coaching System for Financial Advisors
claims.lead: Imagine giving a book report in front of the class with a super-smart invisible friend whispering in your ear: "They look confused, try explaining it differently," or "Great job, now mention the cool part."
claims.detail: This invention is that invisible, super-smart friend for financial advisors during real client meetings. Thirteen AIs listen to the conversation, notice when the client is confused, worried, or asking a tough question, and whisper suggestions to the advisor in real time. They predict the client's objections five to ten minutes before they arrive and produce the calculations, strategies, and printouts that answer them, so the results can be shown, printed, or emailed before the question is even asked.

claims.name: Wealth Genome Scoring and Classification System
claims.lead: Just like your DNA is a unique code that makes you who you are, your "Wealth Genome" is the unique financial code based on twenty-plus factors about your money life.
claims.detail: This invention reads your financial DNA, your income, debts, family size, risk comfort level, job type, age, health, and more, and gives you a special score that suggests which strategies to model first, based on your facts. It is like the sorting hat from Harry Potter, but instead of picking your Hogwarts house, it points to the plans worth testing first.

claims.name: Retirement Income Tax Waterfall Engine
claims.lead: When you retire, you have money in lots of different buckets: your Roth IRA, regular IRA, Social Security, a pension, rental income, life insurance, annuity income. The government taxes each bucket differently.
claims.detail: This invention is like a master plumber who connects all your money buckets with pipes and valves, then models the order to turn each valve to lower the taxes you pay over your retirement, based on your facts. For some households the modeled savings run to hundreds of thousands of dollars or more; yours depend on your numbers and on tax law, which can change.

claims.name: Divorce Asset Protection Calculator with Irrevocable Trust and IUL Shielding
claims.lead: Imagine you have a treasure chest, and you are worried someone might try to take half of it. This invention is like a map that shows which parts of the chest your state's rules may protect, and which they may not, while there is still time to plan.
claims.detail: It models the protection laws for all fifty states and up to five different what-if divorce scenarios, showing which of your assets may be protected and which may be exposed. Planning has to happen before any claim arises, and every result needs a licensed attorney's review.

claims.name: Behavioral Lock-In Prevention System
claims.lead: You know how sometimes you really want to buy a toy just because your friend has one, even though you do not actually need it? Adults have the same pattern with their money.
claims.detail: This invention is like an early-warning system for financial decisions. It detects when someone is about to make an emotionally charged decision and sell at a loss because of a common behavioral bias. Our system reaches out to them in advance, shows them evidence of the real numbers, and helps them take a week or a month off from selling, digest the history of what has happened before, and think clearly.

claims.name: Mortgage Elimination Through Real Estate Recycling and IUL Arbitrage
claims.lead: Imagine your house has a hundred thousand dollars of equity sitting in it. This invention models pulling part of that equity out, paying it into a permanent life insurance policy's cash value, letting it be credited at the rate you assume, and using policy loans to pay down your mortgage faster.
claims.detail: Then you can model the cycle again with the new equity, like a snowball rolling downhill. The engine shows, for your inputs, how often a cycle might repeat and when two could overlap. Every figure is hypothetical: policy charges, loan interest, borrowing costs and home values can slow the cycle or stop it.

claims.name: Time Machine Dual-View Method
claims.lead: Insurance companies illustrate future values under Actuarial Guideline 49-A, an NAIC rule the states apply. The Time Machine adds a second view: how the same crediting formula would have credited on real index history.
claims.detail: You see what the policy's crediting formula would have credited if you had started ten, twenty, or thirty years ago, right beside the illustration the rules require. The required forward view and the historical back-test, side by side, so you can ask better questions. Past index performance is not indicative of future results, and a back-test applies today's caps to years when they did not exist.

claims.name: Twelve-Month Roth Conversion Tax Offset Modeling Engine
claims.lead: Converting retirement money from a regular IRA to a Roth IRA can be smart, because qualified Roth withdrawals are tax-free. But the conversion is taxable income in the year you do it, and this invention models ways to offset that tax.
claims.detail: It searches a hundred different deductions, depreciation schedules and credits that may offset part, and for some households all, of the conversion tax in the same year, based on your facts. It is like using one receipt to pay for another purchase. Results depend on your income, the law in force that year and whether you qualify for each item, so every item needs your CPA's review before you act.

claims.name: FIA Collateral Assignment Lending Optimization System
claims.lead: Imagine a fixed indexed annuity, an insurance contract, that you split into two sections. One section, the bigger one, about seventy percent, can serve as collateral for a bank loan, if a lender accepts it. The other section, about thirty percent, generates income for you.
claims.detail: This invention models ways to split a fixed indexed annuity into a collateral sleeve and an income sleeve, how much a lender might advance against it, and when. It can pair that with oil and gas programs, which are securities with risk of loss, whose deductions may reduce taxable income from capital gains, W-2 wages or IRA conversions. Surrender charges, loan interest and lender terms all apply, and every item needs your CPA's review.

claims.name: Top Ten Ecological Drivers of Retirement Success and Risk-Failure Assessment Framework
claims.lead: Ten threats can derail a retirement, and many of them rarely come up in a typical planning meeting.
claims.detail: These threats have little to do with your average rate of return, or with how consistent it is. They can make an average rate of return far less useful than it looks. You deserve to know what they are. It is not only the average rate of return.

claims.name: Monte Carlo Simulation Engine for Floor-and-Cap Crediting with Holographic Account Value Display
claims.lead: Imagine you want to know if your umbrella will keep you dry, so you test it in ten thousand different rainstorms: light drizzle, heavy downpour, sideways wind, everything.
claims.detail: This invention does the same thing with an indexed universal life insurance policy's account. It runs ten thousand what-if scenarios using random market conditions to see how the account might perform in the best case, the worst case, and everything in between. Here is the special part. Index credits cannot fall below the contract's floor, often zero percent, even when the market crashes, and a cap limits the gains, which makes the math completely different from a normal investment account. Policy charges and loan interest still reduce the account value, so the engine subtracts them. It shows the hypothetical account value as a holographic display, along with how much could be available as a policy loan under the carrier's terms.

claims.name: Automated Advisor Practice Revenue and Territory Strategy Platform
claims.lead: Imagine you are running a lemonade stand and you have a super-smart robot assistant that does eight different jobs for you.
claims.detail: It predicts how much money you will make next month, shows you the best street corners to set up on, lets you practice your sales pitch with an AI customer, checks what competing stands are charging, finds new customers, reminds you to call back customers who have not bought in a while, shows you a timeline of all your income, and sends you alerts when something important happens. This invention is that robot assistant for financial advisors running their entire business.

claims.name: The Report Card Machine
claims.lead: Imagine a weather forecaster getting a report card after the rainy day finally arrives. They may have predicted "lots of rain," but now everyone can look outside and measure what really happened.
claims.detail: The Report Card Machine does that for economic advisers' forecasts. It connects each prediction in your advisers' track record and consulting to a public series of records that demonstrates the real results. Then the machine checks how close their predictions were, and it grades the source that kept changing its story when it published the same year's number.

claims.name: The Truth Stack
claims.lead: The Truth Stack is like building a Lego tower where every brick must click into the right place.
claims.detail: It helps a dozen AI platforms work together as one forecasting team that uses real numbers without making up any pretend ones. The numbers begin on public pages, sourced, verified and shared with you, then the witness rule checks each one: the AI team must point to the exact sentence and number, and the source reference and citation must actually be inside that sentence. If the number passes, it moves into the owner's approval queue. After approval, the number travels to the forecasters' panel, where each forecaster makes predictions. Later, when the real outcome arrives, the system automatically grades each forecaster against what really happened, like checking a spelling test with the answer key. Finally, the proof travels into truth boxes that carry it onto every page where the number appears, so the number never wanders away from its receipt. Each engine also has a list of things it must NEVER print, like a playground rule that says this gate stays closed. The exciting part is that the system cannot make things up just by trying harder.

claims.name: Program Survival Odds Engine
claims.lead: Every federal forgiveness program expansion and cut since nineteen eighty-seven is stamped with who held power in that year.
claims.detail: From that record the system computes the political correlation and prints the sample size, with court rulings separated from political changes. The annual chance that a program does not survive is calculated with a Jeffreys estimate: one half divided by the number of years the program has existed, plus one. For programs that exist only by regulation, that yearly hazard is doubled. Next, the hazard is tilted by one point five minus the expected lever share from a political weather radar, and borrower execution persistence multiplies in each year. The output reports the forgiveness arrival month, amount, tax, odds and confidence.

claims.name: Career-to-Home Engine
claims.lead: First, the system determines what becoming a doctor really costs. It compares that cost with peers only when five or more peers exist.
claims.detail: The career cost is then handed to the question of what the doctor can afford in their ZIP code. The system names the reason for the affordability result instead of giving an unexplained answer. The result is passed into a chained calculator, where each part feeds the next, creating a continuous path. At the end, the exit confidence score checks whether the path helped the person understand the journey. The system therefore connects training, comparison, location, affordability, calculation and confidence.

claims.name: The Financial Suitcase Saver
claims.lead: Think of tax strategies like items packed into a suitcase. If you tossed everything in randomly, the suitcase would not close.
claims.detail: This system packs twenty-nine strategy families in a fixed order every year, so each item gets placed only when there is room and when its rules are ready. First come the basic items, then the structure-free reducers sorted by certainty and cost, then the deduction engines, carefully sized to fit under the target tax bracket while respecting special limits. Roth conversion goes in last, like the final shirt placed on top after everything else has made room. For some households the model finds room for the entire IRA conversion within one year, so qualified Roth withdrawals later can be tax-free. No guarantees, and you must speak to a tax adviser.

claims.name: The Inheritance Arrival Meter
claims.lead: This invention helps a family see an expected inheritance the way a tax system sees it, not just as "money coming later." Think of it like a package sorting station: every future gift gets a different label before it arrives.
claims.detail: Some packages are tax-free. Some bring ordinary income tax. Some have special gains rules. The meter also does not pretend every future inheritance is certain; it weighs each item by how likely it is to arrive. It also suggests ideas to discuss with your tax adviser for reducing the tax on what arrives, based on your facts. Talk to your tax adviser before acting on any of them.

claims.name: The Inheritance Timing Dial
claims.lead: The system treats an inheritance as uncertain in three ways: when it arrives, how much remains after tax, and whether it arrives at all.
claims.detail: The benefactor's survival curve from the Social Security life table sets the timing spread, and the Inheritance Arrival Meter sets the after-tax amount for each possible year. The forecaster panel's confidence sets the width of the band, and the likelihood weighs it. The output is one dated range with a stated reason for its width. The system refuses to produce a result when the gain share is missing.

claims.name: The Black Box Advice Packet
claims.lead: Like a flight recorder, a black box helps explain what happened during a flight. The Black Box Advice Packet does something similar for recommendations.
claims.detail: It creates one replayable packet containing the exact facts as fingerprints, the source quotations, the calculations, the signer, and every later change. If a regulator or a client's lawyer asks, "What happened here?", the packet can show the trail. It is not just a final answer in a folder. It is more like a puzzle built with a picture of every piece, the instructions, the person who approved it, and the changes made afterward. The packet separates a recommendation's ingredients from its result: what information was used, how the calculations worked, who signed it, and what changed later.
